brand.welcomeMessage: Hello! Welcome to Colbolt. I can help you find products (like Bacteriostatic Water, Tirz, Retatrutide), check prices within your budget, or add items directly to your cart. How can I help you today?

company.aboutUs: Colbolt provides premium quality research solutions, laboratory compounds, and peptides with rigorous quality control, verified purity, and discreet fast delivery. Scientific aur research purposes ke liye verified products provide karte hain.
company.shippingPolicy: Orders are processed securely and dispatched within 24-48 business hours with tracking provided.
company.deliveryEstimate: Standard US shipping takes 3-5 business days; expedited options available at checkout.
company.returnPolicy: Due to the nature of research products, returns are handled individually if items arrive damaged or incorrect.

faqs.question: What does Colbolt do? / Aap kya kaam karte hain?
faqs.answer: Colbolt is an online store offering laboratory research compounds, peptides, and solutions such as Tirz (10mg/30mg), Retatrutide, and Bacteriostatic Water with verified quality.

faqs.question: How do I buy or add items to cart?
faqs.answer: You can simply ask me about any product or click the 'Add to Cart' button on the product cards in our chat. The item is directly added to your website cart!

faqs.question: Where can I see my cart and checkout?
faqs.answer: Once you add an item, you can click 'View Cart' or proceed directly to checkout at https://colbolt.hawksnfox.com/checkout/.

faqs.question: Do you ship discreetly?
faqs.answer: Yes, all packages are shipped discreetly and securely.
